'''Bellava Parnadee''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[general]] in the [[First Order military|armed forces]] of the [[First Order]]. As the senior ground [[commander]] of the [[First Order military]], she sat on [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] [[First Order Supreme Council]] and in [[35 ABY]] attended a session on board the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']]. During the meeting, Parnadee complimented the Supreme Leader's newly repaired [[Kylo Ren's helmet|mask]] and suggested that they increase recruitment of personnel when he brought up the [[Final Order|Sith fleet]] that would soon be bolstering the First Order's forces.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Kylo Ren|I sense… unease, about my appearance, General Hux.|Armitage Hux|About the mask? No, sir. Well done. |Bellava Parnadee|I like it.|attr=Kylo Ren, Armitage Hux, and Bellava Parnadee discuss Ren's newly repaired mask|src=<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>}}
[[File:Hux_Parnadee_and_Engel.png|thumb|left|250px|Parnadee was a part of the First Order's Supreme Council.]]
Bellava Parnadee was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who held the rank of [[general]] within the [[First Order]] and served as its senior ground [[commander]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and chief strategist<ref name="Junior">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]''</ref> during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] with the [[Resistance]]. Once much of [[the galaxy]] had fallen under First Order control following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], Parnadee focused on the occupation of contested worlds and directed ground forces on [[Torost]], [[Odynnia Gavo]], and the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]]. She operated out of [[Allegiant General]] [[Enric Pryde]]'s command vessel, the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']], but had standing quarters on every vessel in the [[First Order Navy|First Order fleet]] in case she needed to personally oversee a campaign.<ref name="TROS VD" />

Parnadee sat upon the [[First Order Supreme Council|Supreme Council]], a body within [[First Order High Command]] of the highest ranking [[First Order military|military]] [[First Order officer|officers]] and their [[aide]]s formed by [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] to plan the future of the First Order. In [[35 ABY]], she attended a meeting of the council on board the ''Steadfast'' in which Ren presented the head of the [[Resistance]] sympathizer [[Boolio]] and declared that there was a [[spy]] within the First Order. When the Supreme Leader felt General [[Armitage Hux]] was feeling uneasy about the newly repaired [[Kylo Ren's helmet|mask]] Ren was wearing, Parnadee quickly declared that she personally liked the look after Hux congratulated Supreme Leader Ren for fixing it.<ref name="TROS" />

[[File:Quinn_execution.png|thumb|right|250px|Parnadee witnessed the execution of Domaric Quinn.]]
When Ren began discussing the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]], that would soon bolster their ranks,<ref name="TROS" /> Parnadee went immediately to logistics<ref name="Junior" /> and suggested to General [[Amret Engell]],<ref name="TROSEE">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''</ref> who handled the First Order's [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] training program,<ref name="TROS VD" /> that the First Order should increase recruitment of new personnel from occupied worlds. General [[Domaric Quinn]] then questioned the use of the fleet,<ref name="TROS" /> making the rest of the council uneasy,<ref name="TROSEE" /> but Ren used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|slam]] him into the ceiling.<ref name="TROS" /> As he choked Quinn to [[death]],<ref name="TROSEE" /> Ren ordered Parnadee and the rest of the council to crush any remaining resistance to their rule while he and his [[Knights of Ren]] hunted down the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Bellava Parnadee was a female human with [[Color|black]] [[hair]], dark skin, and brown [[eye]]s. She was an avid student of history and maintained an extensive hololibrary containing detailed analysis of the major engagements of the [[Clone Wars]] and [[Galactic Civil War]]. Her presence encouraged her troops, as they either wished to make her proud or avoid her well-documented ire.<ref name="TROS VD" /> She had a gift for leadership, and her strength of character gained her respect on all levels of the military hierarchy.<ref name="altaya">{{EncyclopediaCite|The First Order}}</ref>

Parnadee knew when and how to give opinions that favored her among her superiors: when she realized that Supreme Leader Kylo Ren singled out General Hux for his unease at his appearance, Parnadee stated that she liked Ren's mask.<ref name="TROS" /> She was able to handle [[Politics|political]] tension, and was not shy about giving praise to a superior in order to gain their favor.<ref name="altaya" /> When suggesting that the First Order recruit more children she spoke with more than a hint of glee in her voice.<ref name="TROSEE" />

==Skills and abilities==
Parnadee was an efficient officer. She was effective both on the battlefield and when commanding troops.<ref name="altaya" />

==Equipment==
While at the meeting of the Supreme Council, Parnadee wore a freshly [[droid]]-ironed black [[First Order military uniforms|First Order uniform]] with a black [[belt]] and [[glove]]s. On her left arm she bore the double-banded rank insignia of a general.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Her [[boot]]s were well used.<ref name="altaya" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bellava Parnadee first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], in which she was portrayed by [[Tanya Moodie]]. The character's last name was listed in the films credits,<ref name="TROS" /> while her first name was first revealed in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> The [[2020]] [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] of the film by [[Michael Kogge]] incorrectly attributes Parnadee's line concerning Ren's mask to [[Amret Engell]].<ref name="Junior" />
